name: radiation_blast
description: One-dimensional nonequilibrium radiation diffusion with blast initial state; backward Euler and analytic FD-discretization Jacobian.
notes: The grid has two unknowns per point, so da_grid_x=512 produces a 1024-by-1024 matrix.
rd_initial=2 selects the blast initial state; rd_initial=1 selects the distinct Marshak-wave problem.
